context: A teacher walks a teen through cultural studies
purpose: Teach: どり/いふ/叶え/生きよ/暮らせる/堪え/年表/きたり

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、研究の段どり、論理的にまとまりましたね。
lines.en: Sakura, your research outline has come together very logically.
lines.style: Warm approval, measured pace. Light nod in the voice. Professional but genuinely pleased—the tone of a teacher who sees real thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古典で、「いふ」が頻出する文体、読みました。
lines.en: Yes. I read through classical texts where 'iu' appears frequently.
lines.style: Focused and careful. Slight lift on 「はい」—eager to show she's understood the task. Direct, no flourish. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物語の中で、登場人物が夢を叶える展開、印象的でしたね。
lines.en: The way characters fulfill their wishes within the narrative was really striking.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering aloud. Gentle pace. Leaning slightly forward in attention. Inviting Sakura to see what she saw.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。現代に生きようとする若者の姿、重なります。
lines.en: Yes. It resonates with how young people today are trying to live.
lines.style: Quiet conviction beneath the surface. Not tentative—she means this. Deliberate, no rushing. The voice of someone making a real connection.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人々が安心して暮らせる時代、いつ実現するでしょうね。
lines.en: I wonder when we'll see an era where people can live without that kind of anxiety.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself but audible. Slight exhale. Slower pace—letting the weight of the question sit. Not rhetorical, genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。長い不安に堪える人々の生き様、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I explored how people endure and live through such prolonged uncertainty.
lines.style: Steady and clear. Pride in her own thinking, but held lightly. Respectful eye-contact level. The voice of someone who has thought deeply about this.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 年表、視覚的に分かりやすかったですね、レポート。
lines.en: Your timeline was visually very easy to follow in the report.
lines.style: Affirming and specific. Slight warmth—she's noting the craft, not just the idea. Quick, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。地域のしきたり、フィールドワークで取材しました。
lines.en: Yes. I conducted fieldwork interviews to gather information about local customs and traditions.
lines.style: Factual but warm. Slight pride in the effort. Close, natural ending—not performing, just finishing simply.
